title: 第23章 丹药再成小姨子再遭殃第24章 小舅子也来了进锅吧
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 陈家。
龙暝看了眼天色，天黑了，儿子和丈夫还没回来，整天都不见人。
“这两个人跑到哪里去了？”
走来走去的她，时不时看向门口，没有等到两人回来。
大概过了半个小时的样子，龙暝等得不耐烦了，要出门寻找。
大门外面走来了两道身影，人没到，味道先到。
“好臭。”
龙暝皱眉，捂住鼻子，那股味道无法遮挡，哪怕捂住鼻子之后，还是能够嗅到。
太难闻了，太恶心了。
“这是什么味道？”
龙暝忍着恶臭味道走上去，迎接自己的丈夫和儿子，往前走了两步路，那股恶臭味道冲上心头，她停下脚步，奇怪看向了周围，寻找臭味的来源，最后，锁定在了两道身影上。
那些恶臭味道是从他们身上散发出来的，龙暝顿时不爽道：“你们身上是什么味道？先不要进来。”
臭死她了，那股味道太刺鼻了，让她无法忍受。
陈渊和陈初升停止前进的脚步，他们两人对视一眼，十分尴尬。
一路回来，那些人避如蛇蝎一样躲避他们，回到家了，以为会改变，谁知道，还是被嫌弃了。
“父亲，说你呢，臭死人了。”
陈渊张开嘴巴，想要说话，却发现自己儿子抢走了自己的话语，这应该他说的话。
狠狠瞪了一眼儿子，这个儿子需要好好教育一番，不然，他真的要上天了。
“那个媳妇，为夫……”
还没走上去的他立刻被勒令停止。
龙暝嫌弃道：“你们不要走进来，就站在外面。”
“说吧，到底发生了什么？为何你们身上一股恶臭？”
陈渊看了一眼儿子，陈初升为难解释。
一通解释之后，事情的原委出来了。
龙暝听完之后，眉头舒展，还是忍不住厌恶。
“所以，你们被初阳给留下来？成为他的炼药童子？”
“嗯嗯。”
“都怪父亲，要不是父亲，我就不用……”
陈初升嘀咕道。
陈渊忍不住了，直接抬脚。
可怜的陈初升被踹飞出去三米，狠狠砸在地上，可怜兮兮。
他还要上去补一脚，这一个儿子不打不行了，太不懂得尊重他这个父亲了。
content_en:
Chen family.
Long Ming glanced at the sky. It was getting dark. His son and husband hadn't come back yet, and they hadn't seen anyone all day.
"Where did these two people go?"
She walked around, looking at the door from time to time, but did not wait for the two of them to come back.
After about half an hour, Long Ming became impatient and wanted to go out to search.
Two figures walked outside the gate. Before the people arrived, the smell arrived first.
"It stinks."
Long Ming frowned and covered his nose. The smell could not be blocked. Even after covering his nose, he could still smell it.
It smells so bad, so disgusting.
"What does this smell like?"
Long Ming endured the stench and walked up to greet her husband and son. She took two steps forward. The stench hit her heart. She stopped and looked around strangely, looking for the source of the stench. Finally, she locked on two figures.
The stench was emanating from their bodies. Long Ming suddenly felt unhappy and said, "What's the smell on you? Don't come in yet."
It stank to death. The smell was so pungent that she couldn't stand it.
Chen Yuan and Chen Chusheng stopped moving forward. They looked at each other, very embarrassed.
All the way back, those people avoided them like snakes and scorpions. When they returned home, they thought things would change, but who knew, they would still be disliked.
"Father, what about you? You stink like hell."
Chen Yuan opened his mouth and wanted to speak, but found that his son had snatched away his words, which were what he should have said.
He glared at his son fiercely. This son needs a good education, otherwise, he will really go to heaven.
"That daughter-in-law, for her husband..."
He was immediately ordered to stop before he could step forward.
Long Ming said disgustedly: "Don't come in, just stand outside."
"Tell me, what happened? Why do you smell so bad?"
Chen Yuan glanced at his son, and Chen Chusheng was embarrassed to explain.
After an explanation, the whole story came out.
After hearing this, Long Ming's brows widened, but he still couldn't help feeling disgusted.
"So, you were kept by Chu Yang? To become his medicine refining boy?"
"Yeah."
"It's all my father's fault. If it weren't for my father, I wouldn't have to..."
Chen Chusheng muttered.
Chen Yuan couldn't help it anymore and raised his feet directly.
"Bang."
Poor Chen Chusheng was kicked three meters away and hit the ground hard. He was pitiful.
He wanted to go up and make up for it. This son couldn't survive without beating him. He didn't know how to respect his father.
title_en: Chapter 23: The elixir becomes the sister-in-law again, and the sister-in-law suffers again Chapter 24: The brother-in-law is also here to join the pot
